actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14) from one of four tentacles.

actions.name: Consume Memories
actions.text: *Intelligence Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature within 30 feet that is [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) or [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the aboleth. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Psychic damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) by this action.

more.text: The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed), the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance.

legendary_actions.name: Lash
legendary_actions.text: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

legendary_actions.name: Psychic Drain
legendary_actions.text: If the aboleth has at least one creature [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) or [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled), it uses Consume Memories and regains 5 (1d10) [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points).

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Eldritch Restoration
traits.text: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

more.text: While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 (1d12) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

traits.name: Mucus Cloud
traits.text: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. *Failure:* The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) unless it is underwater.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.text: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks.

actions.name: Thunderous Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6)
actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the elemental's space. *Failure:* 24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the elemental and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

content.text: Animated suits of armor might move with steady deliberateness or awkward gaits. They're often constructed from plate armor, making them easy to mistake for soldiers or helmed horrors. Other types of armor or even metal statuary might also become animated armor.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The armor makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

content.text: Animated flying swords move as if wielded by unseen warriors. Whether an animated blade is newly forged or a constellation of broken fragments, the object behaves the same. Other weapons from the System Reference Document can also be animated and use game statistics similar to those here.

actions.name: Slash
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage.

content.text: Animated rugs of smothering might attack any creature that steps on them, or they might be passed off as superficially similar magic items, such as Carpets of Flying, and attack those who speak a supposed command word. Deadly tapestries, furs, and similar items also use this stat block.

more.text: While grappling the target, the rug can't take this action, the rug halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.

actions.name: Smother
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the rug can give it the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13) instead of dealing damage. Until the grapple ends, the target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions, is suffocating, and takes 10 (2d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The rug can smother only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 (with [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) if the target is [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Acid Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide [Line](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/line). *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 11

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.text: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its [Burrow Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burrow-speed) and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The assassin makes three attacks, using Shortsword or Light Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 17 (5d6) Poison damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the start of the assassin's next turn.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.text: The assassin takes the [Dash](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dash), [Disengage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disengage), or [Hide](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hide) action.

traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the assassin instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save and only half damage if it fails. It can't use this trait if it has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

content.text: Awakened shrubs can be any sort of small plant, from forest bushes to clustered flowers. They often appear near awakened trees or in regions imbued with primal magic. Some have whimsical appearances or foliage resembling rudimentary facial features, while others look like animate topiary creatures.

actions.name: Rake
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +1, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 1 Slashing damage.

content.text: Some awakened trees stand in still, meditative states for long periods, making them easy to mistake for normal plants, while others patrol regions of natural power. Awakened trees are sometimes brought to life by influences from the Feywild, which make them colorful and endlessly blooming, or by Shadowfell energy, which covers them with grotesque burls or makes them look lifeless.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

content.text: Alone or in small groups, axe beaks stalk prey to feed their flocks. When working together, axe beaks use rudimentary tactics, with some distracting threats while others strike vulnerable targets or rush young axe beaks to safety.

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage.

content.text: Azer sentinels defend their communities' smiths and channel their flames through their weapons.

actions.name: Burning Hammer
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the azer's turns, each creature of the azer's choice in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the azer takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage unless the azer has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The azer sheds [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light) in a 10-foot radius and [Dim Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dim-light) for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The balor makes one Flame Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack.

actions.name: Flame Whip
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 18 (3d6 + 8) Force damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Lightning Blade
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (3d8 + 8) Force damage plus 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target can't take Reactions until the start of the balor's next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport
bonus_actions.text: The balor teleports itself or a willing demon within 10 feet of itself up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the balor can see.

traits.name: Death Throes
traits.text: The balor explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature in a 30-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the balor. *Failure:* 31 (9d6) Fire damage plus 31 (9d6) Force damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the balor's turns, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the balor takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The balor has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

content.text: Bandits are inexperienced ne'er-do-wells who typically follow the orders of higher-ranking bandits.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 80/320 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

content.text: Bandit captains command gangs of scoundrels and conduct straightforward heists. Others serve as guards and muscle for more influential criminals.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bandit makes two attacks, using Scimitar and Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The bandit is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The bandit adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or it makes two Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13) from both claws.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 150 ft. *Hit:* 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts [burning](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burning).

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness)), Passive Perception 18

traits.name: Barbed Hide
traits.text: At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 4–6)
bonus_actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). If the basilisk sees its reflection within the [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone), the basilisk must make this save. *First Failure:* The target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained), ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the [Petrified](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/petrified) condition instead of the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.

actions.name: Beard
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the start of the devil's next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points).

actions.name: Infernal Glaive
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *Failure:* The target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses 5 (1d10) [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 12 Wisdom ([Medicine](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/medicine)) check.

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness)), Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The behir makes one Bite attack and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (2d12 + 6) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Large or smaller creature the behir can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 28 (5d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 16), and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 16, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide [Line](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/line). *Failure:* 66 (12d10) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

more.text: If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within 10 feet of the behir and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone).

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, one Large or smaller creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the behir (the behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The behir swallows the target, which is no longer [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled). While swallowed, a creature has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions, has [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover) against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the behir's turns.

content.text: Berserkers might fight for personal glory or form motivated forces or howling hordes.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d12 + 3) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Bloodied Frenzy
traits.text: While [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied), the berserker has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on attack rolls and saving throws.

content.text: Black dragon wyrmlings lurk in bogs and polluted waterways, hunting for prey and weaker creatures to overpower. While older wyrmlings eventually seek their own territories, recently hatched ones might hunt one another, seeking dominance over their clutch and slaying rivals they can't subjugate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot-long, 5-foot-wide [Line](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/line). *Failure:* 22 (5d8) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

content.text: Most young black dragons claim a hidden lair—typically a dismal place accessible through deadly ruins or a treacherous bog. They delight in exploiting fearful servants and might terrorize small communities or impress groups of kobolds or troglodytes into their service. Some ally themselves with powerful undead such as death knights and vampires or aberrations such as aboleths.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide [Line](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/line). *Failure:* 49 (14d6) Acid damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 16

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

content.text: By the time they're adults, black dragons are among the greatest terrors in the lands they claim. Wretched swamps and monster-haunted ruins grow more dismal and spread under an adult black dragon's influence. Morbid cultists and doomsayers frequently gather in the dragon's service, bringing with them undead terrors that answer to the black dragon and aid it in spreading ruin to nearby bastions of beauty and peace.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *[Acid Arrow](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/acid-arrow)* (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

legendary_actions.name: Cloud of Insects
legendary_actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 22 (4d10) Poison damage, and the target has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on saving throws to maintain [Concentration](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/concentration) until the end of its next turn. *Failure or Success:* The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Frightful Presence

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.text: The dragon can move up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.text: The dragon moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary_actions.name: Thunderclap
legendary_actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 22, each creature in a 20-foot-radius [Sphere](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/sphere) centered on a point the dragon can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Thunder damage, and the target has the [Deafened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/deafened) condition until the end of its next turn.

content.text: Bugbear stalkers frequently take their victims hostage, relishing opportunities to imprison and terrorize other creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bugbear makes two Javelin or Morningstar attacks.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 (with [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) if the target is [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Quick Grapple
bonus_actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13).

traits.name: Abduct
traits.text: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

content.text: Bugbear warriors serve those who offer them treasure, food, or the chance to hunt challenging prey.

actions.name: Grab
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Light Hammer
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4 (with [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) if the target is [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 9 (3d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Abduct
traits.text: The bugbear needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

content.text: Bulettes range under vast territories. They often threaten animal herds, and they can wipe out whole farming communities.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Deadly Leap
actions.text: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in the bulette's destination space. *Failure:* 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. *Success:* Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.text: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

data.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 120 ft., Passive Perception 16

content.text: Centaur troopers are knight-like guardians. Many are suspicious of non-Fey creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The centaur makes two attacks, using Pike or Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Pike
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Trampling Charge (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The centaur moves up to its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) without provoking [Opportunity Attacks](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks) and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 14. *Failure:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.

actions.name: Chain
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
actions.text: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. *Success:* The chain disappears.

reactions.name: Unnerving Gaze
reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. *Response—**Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, the triggering creature. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition until the end of its turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness)), Passive Perception 11

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The devil has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on the attack roll.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Ram
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 31 (7d8) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Paralyzing Tentacles
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the chuul. *Failure:* The target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned), the target has the [Paralyzed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/paralyzed) condition.

data.languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The chuul can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Sense Magic
traits.text: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the *[Detect Magic](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/detect-magic)* spell but isn't itself magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Hasten (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The golem takes the [Dash](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dash) and [Disengage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disengage) actions.

traits.name: Acid Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) equal to the Acid damage dealt.

traits.name: Berserk
traits.text: Whenever the golem starts its turn [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied), roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.

more.text: The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength ([Athletics](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/athletics)) check.

actions.name: Attach
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) condition, and the cloaker can't make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Moan
bonus_actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the cloaker. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition until the end of the cloaker's next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this cloaker's Moan for the next 24 hours.

bonus_actions.name: Phantasms (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
bonus_actions.text: The cloaker casts the *[Mirror Image](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/mirror-image)* spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light).

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: While in [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light), the cloaker has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *[Fog Cloud](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/fog-cloud)*.

actions.name: Thunderous Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Thundercloud
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, range 240 ft. *Hit:* 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step
bonus_actions.text: The giant casts the *[Misty Step](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/misty-step)* spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

content.text: Cockatrices often try to claim eye-catching structures—such as ruins and secluded farms—as roosts.

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11. *First Failure:* The target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained), ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the [Petrified](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/petrified) condition, instead of the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition, for 24 hours.

actions.name: Club
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

traits.name: Training
traits.text: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

content.text: Copper dragon wyrmlings venture into the world seeking to make friends and discover wonders. They sometimes get into trouble, but those who help them can become their friends for life.

content.text: Adult copper dragons use their influence to better the world. With broad circles of friends, adult copper dragons delight in introducing people to one another and helping people find places where they can flourish. When disaster strikes, these dragons draw on their family of contacts to offer support, right wrongs, and rebuild stronger than before.

content.text: Swarms of crawling claws are typically animated by depraved necromancers. Occasionally, these grotesque swarms arise from mass graves or after tragedies, refusing to let their murderers escape their grasp.

actions.name: Swarm of Grasping Hands
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage if the swarm is [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied). If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) or gain [Temporary Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/temporary-hit-points).

content.text: Cultists devote themselves to their faith's leaders and otherworldly masters. While this zeal grants cultists no magical powers, it gives them remarkable resolve in the face of threats. Cultists perform much of a cult's mundane work, which might include evangelism, criminal acts, or serving as sacrifices.

actions.name: Ritual Sickle
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.

content.text: Cultist fanatics lead small cults or cells within larger cults. They're privy to more of a cult's mysteries than lower-ranking cultists are, granting them access to magical powers from their patrons.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):

bonus_actions.name: Spiritual Weapon (2/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The cultist casts the *[Spiritual Weapon](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/spiritual-weapon)* spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

more.text: While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on its attack rolls. Its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it moves with the target.

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength ([Athletics](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/athletics)) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Crush
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

actions.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
actions.text: Magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness) fills a 15-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains [Concentration](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/concentration) on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12. *First Failure:* The target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition. While [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned), the target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

actions.name: Holy Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

items.text: **At Will:** *[Detect Evil and Good](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/detect-evil-and-good)*, *[Shapechange](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/shapechange)* (Beast or Humanoid form only, no [Temporary Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/temporary-hit-points) gained from the spell, and no [Concentration](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/concentration) or [Temporary Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/temporary-hit-points) required to maintain the spell)

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The deva casts *[Cure Wounds](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/cure-wounds)*, *[Lesser Restoration](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/lesser-restoration)*, or *[Remove Curse](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/remove-curse)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.text: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The deva has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Blade
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 feet. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Bolt
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 feet. *Hit:* 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

more.text: Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). *Failure:* While in the whirlwind, the target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Create Whirlwind
actions.text: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high [Cylinder](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cylinder) centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's [Concentration](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/concentration) on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns.

items.text: **2/Day Each:** *[Create Food and Water](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/create-food-and-water)* (can create wine instead of water), *[Tongues](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/tongues)*, *[Wind Walk](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/wind-walk)*

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere on the Plane of Air.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The djinni has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the *[Wish](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/wish)* spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6 (with [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.text: The doppelganger casts *[Detect Thoughts](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/detect-thoughts)*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).

actions.name: Unsettling Visage (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.text: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant [Resistance](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/resistance) to this Fire damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 56 (16d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* Being underwater doesn't grant [Resistance](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/resistance) to this Fire damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The dragon can breathe air and water.

content.text: Lone dretches serve other demons or evil magic-users. They are erratic, filthy, and violent, and they demonstrate little sense of self-preservation.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the dretch. *Failure:* The target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the end of its next turn. While [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned), the creature can take either an action or a [Bonus Action](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bonus-action) on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

data.languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Poison Burst
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Magic of the Spider Queen (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The drider casts *[Darkness](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/darkness)*, *[Faerie Fire](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/faerie-fire)*, or *[Web](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/web)*, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the drider has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on ability checks and attack rolls.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 90 ft. *Hit:* 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast *[Charm Monster](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/charm-monster)*.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Thorn Burst
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

items.text: **At Will:** *[Animal Friendship](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/animal-friendship)*, *[Charm Monster](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/charm-monster)* (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again), *[Druidcraft](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/druidcraft)*

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

bonus_actions.name: Tree Stride
bonus_actions.text: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The dryad has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.text: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock Launch
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

data.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Heated Blade
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 13 (2d12) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +8, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 24 (7d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

traits.name: Elemental Restoration
traits.text: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The efreeti has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Wishes
traits.text: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the *[Wish](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/wish)* spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

actions.name: Withering Sword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 16, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 14 (4d6) Force damage, and the target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a [Bonus Action](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bonus-action) to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.text: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The erinyes has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Rope
traits.text: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and [Immunity](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/immunity) to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a [Short](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/short-rest) or [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Web Strand (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; [Vulnerability](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/vulnerability) to Fire damage; [Immunity](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/immunity) to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonus_actions.name: Reel
bonus_actions.text: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Morningstar
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

actions.name: Burn
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts [burning](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burning).

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the elemental takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) start [burning](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burning).

traits.name: Fire Form
traits.text: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) Fire damage.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.text: The elemental sheds [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light) in a 30-foot radius and [Dim Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dim-light) for an additional 30 feet.

traits.name: Water Susceptibility
traits.text: The elemental takes 3 (1d6) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

actions.name: Flame Sword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 21 (4d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hammer Throw
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +11, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 23 (3d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Lightning damage.

data.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.text: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

more.text: The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a DC 15 Charisma ([Persuasion](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/persuasion)) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied).

traits.name: Berserk
traits.text: Whenever the golem starts its turn [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied), roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied).

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.

actions.name: Frost Axe
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 19 (2d12 + 6) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Great Bow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 17 (2d10 + 6) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage, and the target's [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: War Cry (Recharge 5–6)

content.text: If exposed to light or otherwise disturbed, mushroom-like shriekers emit a high-pitched noise that gives them their name. This wailing might alert other creatures or attract predators.

reactions.name: Shriek
reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature or a source of [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light) moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. *Response:* The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.

content.text: Slow but mobile, violet fungi rot any flesh they touch with their lashing tendrils.

actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an [Opportunity Attack](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks) when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: The cube moves up to its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) without provoking [Opportunity Attacks](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks). The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze [Cube](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cube) trait). *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. *Failure:* 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength ([Athletics](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/athletics)) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. *Success:* Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

more.text: Creatures inside the cube have [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover), and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time.

As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength ([Athletics](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/athletics)) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.text: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on the saving throw.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.text: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom ([Perception](srd-5.2/01/proficiency/skill-proficiencies/skill-list/perception)) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn't witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

content.text: Ghasts frequently organize ghouls into packs to despoil crypts and steal the wealth within.

traits.name: Stench
traits.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the ghast. *Failure:* The target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 19 (3d10 + 3) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.text: The ghost casts the *[Etherealness](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/etherealness)* spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability. The ghost is visible on the Material Plane while on the Border Ethereal and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Horrific Visage
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone) that can see the ghost and isn't an Undead. *Failure:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Psychic damage, and the target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition until the start of the ghost's next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this ghost's Horrific Visage for 24 hours.

more.text: The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) or the ghost leaves as a [Bonus Action](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bonus-action). When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's [Possession](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/possession) for 24 hours. *Success:* The target is immune to this ghost's [Possession](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/possession) for 24 hours.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

content.text: Most gorgons are iron bulls wreathed in clouds of petrifying gas. Their metal plates vary in sheen and color, from sleek silver to pitted black. The oldest gorgons might be covered in rust, but this rarely impedes their abilities. These gorgons' stomping grounds are littered with the shattered remains of [petrified](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/petrified) foes. Many gorgons outlive their creators by centuries, misleading some to believe these creations have natural origins and territories. Most such gorgons continue to follow age-old commands, guarding sites long fallen to ruin.

actions.name: Gore
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (2d12 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the gorgon moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Petrifying Breath (Recharge 5–6)

traits.name: Corrosive Form
traits.text: Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the ooze and dealing any damage. The penalty can be removed by casting the *[Mending](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/mending)* spell on the weapon.

If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn't avoid [Opportunity Attacks](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks); however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. *Success:* The target is immune to this harpy's Luring Song for 24 hours.
