actions.text: The imp casts *[Invisibility](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/invisibility)* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat ([Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed). Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness)), Passive Perception 11

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The imp has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.

actions.name: Restless Touch
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

bonus_actions.name: Nightmare (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* If the target has 20 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) or fewer, it has the [Unconscious](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/unconscious) condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Succubus Form
traits.text: When the incubus finishes a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), it can shape-shift into a [Succubus](srd-5.2/14/succubus/succubus), using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.

actions.name: Wind Swipe
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.

actions.name: Vortex
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker's space. *Failure:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can't cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker's turns.

traits.name: Air Form
traits.text: The stalker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Invisibility
traits.text: The stalker has the [Invisible](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/invisible) condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Bladed Arm
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 36 (8d8) Fire damage.

actions.name: Poison Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 55 (10d10) Poison damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) equal to the Fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

content.text: Knights frequently lead troops in combat or work in units that dominate the battlefield. They're often attended by squires, who might be less skilled soldiers or commoners.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +2, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

content.text: Kobold warriors use hit-and-run tactics to raid their enemies and defend their homes. To avoid danger, they frequently employ haphazard traps.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The kobold has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the kobold has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Fling
actions.text: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn't in the air. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. *Success:* Half damage only.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. *Failure:* 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

more.text: If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone).

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 25, one creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled). A swallowed creature has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition, has [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover) against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.

data.languages: Understands Abyssal, Celestial, Infernal, and Primordial but can't speak; telepathy 120 ft.

legendary_actions.name: Storm Bolt
legendary_actions.text: The kraken uses Lightning Strike.

legendary_actions.name: Toxic Ink
legendary_actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the kraken while it is underwater. *Failure:* The target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) conditions until the end of the kraken's next turn. The kraken then moves up to its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed). *Failure or Success:* The kraken can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the kraken can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The kraken regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The kraken can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lamia makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Corrupting Touch.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Corrupting Touch
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature the lamia can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) and [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) conditions.

items.text: **At Will:** *[Disguise Self](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/disguise-self)* (can appear as a Large or Medium biped), *[Minor Illusion](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/minor-illusion)*

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The lamia casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.text: The lamia jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

content.text: Lemures torment weaker creatures, but in the Nine Hells, few such beings exist. To avoid greater suffering, they obey the orders of more powerful devils.

actions.name: Vile Slime
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. (unimpeded by magical [Darkness](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/darkness)), Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Hellish Restoration
traits.text: If the lemure dies in the Nine Hells, it revives with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a creature under the effects of a *[Bless](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/bless)* spell or its remains are sprinkled with [Holy Water](srd-5.2/06/adventuring-gear/holy-water).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lich makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

actions.name: Eldritch Burst
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the [Paralyzed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/paralyzed) condition until the start of the lich's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

legendary_actions.name: Deathly Teleport
legendary_actions.text: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Disrupt Life
legendary_actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 20, each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the lich. *Failure:* 31 (9d6) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Frightening Gaze
legendary_actions.text: The lich casts *[Fear](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/fear)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the lich can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The lich regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Protective Magic
reactions.text: The lich casts *[Counterspell](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/counterspell)* or *[Shield](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/shield)* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Spirit Jar
traits.text: If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points). The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich's lair.

content.text: Mages are accomplished spellcasters whose lives have been shaped by magic. They can use their powers to defend or dominate other creatures, or they could focus on magical research and unlocking mystical secrets.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. *Hit:* 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The mage casts *[Misty Step](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/misty-step)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.text: The mage casts *[Counterspell](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/counterspell)* or *[Shield](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/shield)* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

content.text: Archmages have mastered incredible magical power. While some use their magic to protect the world, others become tyrants or pursue forbidden secrets. Many archmages retain magical servants and collect magic items and occult lore.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The archmage makes four Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. or range 150 ft. *Hit:* 27 (4d10 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The archmage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

bonus_actions.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The mage casts *[Misty Step](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/misty-step)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

reactions.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
reactions.text: The archmage casts *[Counterspell](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/counterspell)* or *[Shield](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/shield)* in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The archmage has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Touch
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts [burning](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burning).

bonus_actions.name: Ignited Illumination
bonus_actions.text: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds [Bright Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bright-light) in a 10-foot radius and [Dim Light](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dim-light) for an additional 10 feet.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The magmin explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the magmin. *Failure:* 7 (2d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail Spike
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 100/200 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

actions.name: Pact Blade
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14), and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

bonus_actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The marilith has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.text: The marilith can take one [Reaction](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/reaction) on every turn of combat.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Snake Hair
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Poison Ray
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 150 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Petrifying Gaze (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). If the medusa sees its reflection in the [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone), the medusa must make this save. *First Failure:* The target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained), ending the effect on itself on a success. *Second Failure:* The target has the [Petrified](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/petrified) condition instead of the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition.

content.text: Dust mephits are composed of air and fine earth. They are drawn to forsaken places, and they think everything associated with death is hilarious.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Blinding Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* The target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

actions.name: Sleep (1/Day)
actions.text: The mephit casts the *[Sleep](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/sleep)* spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 10).

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the mephit. *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Bludgeoning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

content.text: Ice mephits have bodies made of frigid air and frozen water. They delight in freezing things and dropping ice into peoples' clothes.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.

actions.name: Fog Cloud (1/Day)
actions.text: The mephit casts *[Fog Cloud](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/fog-cloud)*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 7 (3d4) Cold damage. *Success:* Half damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the mephit. *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Cold damage. *Success:* Half damage.

content.text: These mephits embody the merging of earth and fire as glowing magma. They love melting things, but they loathe magmins and attack them on sight.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 7 (2d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the mephit. *Failure:* 7 (2d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

content.text: These arrogant mephits are made of heat and vaporous water. They often trick creatures into doing them favors, then renege on promised rewards.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only. *Failure or Success:* Being underwater doesn't grant [Resistance](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/resistance) to this Fire damage.

traits.name: Blurred Form
traits.text: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) unless the mephit has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.text: The mephit explodes when it dies. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the mephit. *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

content.text: Merfolk skirmishers defend their homes from aquatic monsters and invaders from the surface.

actions.name: Ocean Spear
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. *Hit or Miss:* The spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The merrow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5 (with [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) if the target is [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the mimic), reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage).

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.text: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage).

actions.name: Abyssal Glaive
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gore (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

content.text: Common mummies are the remains of priests, nobles, or champions of faith that underwent magical burial rites. Some are preserved through processes using linen wrappings or clay, but others are preserved by peat bogs, ice, magic, or other means.
Roll on or choose a result from the Mummy Resurrections table to determine why a mummy has returned from the dead.

rows: Defend a holy site it was created to protect.
Obey the summons of a mummy lord.
Oppose an enemy who has returned to life.
Protect its descendants from an ancient threat.
Punish the progeny of those who cursed it.
Reclaim treasures robbed from its crypt.
Serve whoever speaks the prayer on its tomb.
Slay anyone who sets eyes on it.
content.title: Mummy Resurrections

content.text: Rule 7: Before opening a sarcophagus, light a torch.
—*X the Mystic's Rules of Dungeon Survival*

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), its [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), and its [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

content.text: Those desperate to escape death sometimes make terrible bargains with wicked deities. Devoting their hearts to evil forces, these villains gain power over death and a cursed immortality that binds their minds and spirits within a desiccated corpse. Freed from mortal concerns, these mummy lords pursue their obsessions across ages.

Most mummy lords linger amid the ruins of ancient palaces or temples where they once held sway. Their age-old faith and ties to deathly forces grant them fearful magic, which they use to sow ruin and animate undead servants.

A mummy lord's heart embodies the pact that grants it immortality. Rather than bearing its heart within its corpse, a mummy lord removes and hides this accursed organ. As long as its heart isn't destroyed by fire, a mummy lord can return to unlife no matter what doom it meets.
Mummy lords are usually consumed by ageless plots. Roll on or choose a result from the Mummy Lord Plots table to determine a mummy lord's ancient agenda.

rows: Open a portal to the past, when its power was at its height.
Perform a ritual that can be attempted only once every eight hundred years.
Reclaim and resurrect a loved one's corpse.
Reconquer the lands that once composed its empire.
Recover the pieces of its lost heart.
Replace its descendant as the ruler of a realm.
Sacrifice a thousand souls to its god in return for true life.
Transform the people of an entire nation into Undead servants.
content.title: Mummy Lord Plots

content.label: Mummy Lord Lairs
content.text: Mummy lords typically lurk in the ruins of places they dwelled in life. Such sites have forbidding reputations, or they might be lost and forgotten.

The scroll contained a foul ritual to raise one of the children of Anhktepot. I tried to burn it, but the flames refused to touch the parchment. Forgive me, but I cannot destroy it... and I cannot help myself.
—Isu, High Priest of Muhar

actions.text: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), it gains no benefit from finishing a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), and its [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) by this attack.

actions.name: Channel Negative Energy
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the [Paralyzed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/paralyzed) condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

legendary_actions.name: Dread Command
legendary_actions.text: The mummy casts *[Command](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/command)* (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Glare
legendary_actions.text: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Necrotic Strike
legendary_actions.text: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the mummy lord can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The mummy lord regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

reactions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The mummy is hit by an attack roll. *Response:* The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The mummy has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.text: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points). The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and [Immunity](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/immunity) to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.text: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus_actions.name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the nalfeshnee. *Failure:* 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. *Success:* The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Pursuit
reactions.text: *Trigger:* Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. *Response:* The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.text: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The nalfeshnee has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

more.text: If the target takes damage from the *[Dream](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/dream)* spell, the target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day; Requires Soul Bag)
actions.text: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts *[Dream](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/dream)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the *[Protection from Evil and Good](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/protection-from-evil-and-good)* spell or within a *[Magic Circle](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/magic-circle)* spell.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.text: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): *[Augury](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/augury)*, *[Find Familiar](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/find-familiar)*, *[Identify](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/identify)*, *[Locate Object](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/locate-object)*, *[Scrying](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scrying)*, or *[Unseen Servant](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/unseen-servant)*. The hag must finish a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest) before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The hag has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

more.text: The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and [Resistance](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/resistance) to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points). If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

traits.name: Soul Bag

content.text: A noble's social advantages typically grant the noble access to greater education and training than most common folk, while nobles' experience with business or politics makes many adept negotiators.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

reactions.text: *Trigger:* While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), it becomes [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied) or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. *Response:* The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative). The original jelly's [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

content.text: Ogres are 10-foot-tall brutes that overwhelm their foes and take what spoils they please. Ogre raiders ally with other evil forces in return for food, riches, and promises of battle.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

Whenever the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) target finishes a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15. *Failure:* The target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn't return to normal until the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition ends on the target. *Success:* The [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition ends.

actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, each creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the otyugh. *Failure:* 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the [Stunned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/stunned) condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

actions.text: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), the target becomes [Stable](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/stable), and it has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition for 1 hour. bonus_actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonus_actions.text: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.text: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.text: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

content.text: Along with being competent warriors, pirates are accomplished seafarers who know how to sail and maintain a ship. While some loyally follow their captains' orders, others place greed, superstition, or self-preservation over duty.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enthralling Panache
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

content.text: Pirate captains command crews of pirates, dictating their destinations and targets. Captains cultivate fearsome and theatrical reputations, painting themselves as larger-than-life characters to terrorize their foes, ensure the obedience of their crews, and attract followers to their banner. Many have colorful nicknames inspired by signature traits and deeds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, range 30/90 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Captain's Charm
bonus_actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) condition until the start of the pirate's next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 21. *Failure:* The target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition. While [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned), the target can't regain [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Devilish Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fiery Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (4d6 + 8) Force damage plus 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.text: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) while it doesn't have the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.text: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The pit fiend has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +12, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Burst

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The planetar casts *[Cure Wounds](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/cure-wounds)*, *[Invisibility](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/invisibility)*, *[Lesser Restoration](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/lesser-restoration)*, or *[Remove Curse](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/remove-curse)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.text: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.text: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The planetar has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

content.text: Priest acolytes have great faith but modest magical skill. Some might be trainees in religious organizations or soldiers in zealous armies, while others are faith leaders in small communities or wanderers on pilgrimages.

actions.name: Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (1/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The priest casts *[Bless](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/bless)*, *[Healing Word](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/healing-word)*, or *[Sanctuary](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/sanctuary)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

content.text: Priests draw on their beliefs to heal the needful and smite their foes. They can channel their faith as spells and empower their weapons with divine might.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The priest casts *[Bless](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/bless)*, *[Dispel Magic](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/dispel-magic)*, *[Healing Word](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/healing-word)*, or *[Lesser Restoration](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/lesser-restoration)*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. *Failure:* 5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition for 1 hour. While [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned), the target also has the [Unconscious](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/unconscious) condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

data.languages: Understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
data.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The pseudodragon has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 19), and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

more.text: If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone).

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 19, one Large or smaller creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the worm, and the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition ends. A swallowed creature has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions, has [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover) against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm's turns.

data.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 9

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.text: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its [Burrow Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/burrow-speed) and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the start of the quasit's next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The quasit casts *[Invisibility](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/invisibility)* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Scare (1/Day)
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 10, one creature within 20 feet. *Failure:* The target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.text: The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat ([Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed). Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The quasit has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.

actions.name: Cursed Touch
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a [Short](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/short-rest) or [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest).

actions.name: Baleful Command (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the rakshasa. *Failure:* 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) and [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) conditions until the start of the rakshasa's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.text: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa's permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) somewhere in the Nine Hells.

data.vulnerabilities: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a *[Bless](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/bless)* spell

content.text: Red dragon wyrmlings are born destroyers. From a young age, they delight in igniting objects and creatures alike. They sometimes restrain themselves from scorching creatures to instead bully others into following their orders and bringing them gifts.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 24 (7d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.senses: Blindsight 10 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 14

content.text: Young red dragons number among the most unpredictable of their kind. They seek territories rich with treasures and potential followers, raiding, burning, and slaughtering to enforce their will. Unless these dragons meet significant resistance, they cement their power and begin reigns of terror that can last for centuries.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 56 (16d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

data.senses: Blindsight 30 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 18

content.text: Adult red dragons are tyrants that claim vast domains and might command armies of followers or significant magical resources. Red dragons rarely pay attention to the nations and claims of smaller creatures, and they might consider entire cities part of their realm. Most red dragons are inattentive rulers, though, spending decades focused on their own comforts, hoards, or magical concerns within their lairs. But when their attention returns to their territories, if they find matters not to their liking, whole lands might burn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *[Scorching Ray](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scorching-ray)*.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 13 (1d10 + 8) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 21, each creature in a 60-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 59 (17d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks):

legendary_actions.name: Commanding Presence
legendary_actions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *[Command](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/command)* (level 2 version). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Rays
legendary_actions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *[Scorching Ray](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scorching-ray)*. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.text: The dragon moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Rend attack.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
data.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 23

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

content.text: Ancient red dragons number among the most feared and destructive beings in the multiverse. Few can withstand the wrath of an ancient red dragon that turns its mind toward devastation. These dragons' greed matches their ruinous potential, and they collect vast hoards studded with storied treasures and magic items. Their lairs frequently tap into volcanic depths and might pierce other planes of existence, bringing servants from the Elemental Plane of Fire or the Lower Planes into their service.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *[Scorching Ray](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scorching-ray)* (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +17, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 91 (26d6) Fire damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks):

legendary_actions.name: Commanding Presence
legendary_actions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *[Command](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/command)* (level 2 version). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Rays
legendary_actions.text: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *[Scorching Ray](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scorching-ray)* (level 3 version). The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.text: The dragon moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Rend attack.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the dragon can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The dragon regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
data.senses: Blindsight 60 ft., Darkvision 120 ft., Passive Perception 26

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

content.text: Full-grown remorhazes are single-minded ambush predators. They attempt to bite prey and trap it against their searing bodies, then swallow their meal whole. Remorhazes eat as much as they can, since they might go months without feeding.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 17), and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

more.text: If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone).

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 19, one Large or smaller creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition ends. A swallowed creature has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions, it has [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover) against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz's turns.

data.senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 10

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +13, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

bonus_actions.name: Swoop (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: If the roc has a creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled), the roc flies up to half its [Fly Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/fly-speed) without provoking [Opportunity Attacks](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks) and drops that creature.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

more.text: The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, [Immunity](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/immunity) to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper's next turn.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 60 ft. *Hit:* The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Reel
actions.text: The roper pulls each creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.text: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 11, the creature with the object. *Failure:* The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the *[Mending](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/mending)* spell on the armor or weapon.

actions.name: Destroy Metal
actions.text: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot [Cube](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cube) of the object.

reactions.name: Reflexive Antennae
reactions.text: *Trigger:* An attack roll hits the rust monster. *Response:* The rust monster uses Antennae.

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.text: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

content.text: Sahuagin warriors are vicious combatants that savage their foes with webbed claws. Once sahuagin draw blood, they usually attack until either they or their foe is slain.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +3, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aquatic Charge
bonus_actions.text: The sahuagin swims up to its [Swim Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/swim-speed) straight toward an enemy it can see.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: The sahuagin has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points).

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.text: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.text: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

content.text: Most salamanders are arrogant yet curious, seeking to create artful blazes or burn that which has never been burned. They eagerly explain their work to strangers before trying to determine how the strangers burn. Salamanders radiate intense heat, which is conducted by their blazing weapons.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.

actions.name: Flame Spear
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. *Hit or Miss:* The spear magically returns to the salamander's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. *Failure:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14), and it has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition until the grapple ends.

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.text: At the end of each of the salamander's turns, each creature of the salamander's choice in a 5-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from the salamander takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

content.text: Satyrs enjoy demonstrating their physicality through contests, evicting party poopers, and defending Fey realms.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Mockery
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. *Failure:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The satyr has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

content.text: Scouts are keen archers and acutely aware of their surroundings. They often know several regions particularly well and are familiar with local creatures, landmarks, and perils.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 150/600 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Glare (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 11, one [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) creature the hag can see within 30 feet. *Failure:* If the target has 20 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) or fewer, it drops to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points). Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.text: The hag casts *[Disguise Self](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/disguise-self)*, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell's duration is 24 hours.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.text: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): *[Augury](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/augury)*, *[Find Familiar](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/find-familiar)*, *[Identify](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/identify)*, *[Locate Object](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/locate-object)*, *[Scrying](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/scrying)*, or *[Unseen Servant](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/unseen-servant)*. The hag must finish a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest) before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Vile Appearance

Until the grapple ends, the target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. The shambling mound can have only one creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by this action at a time.

traits.name: Bound

If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The guardian regains 10 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points).

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.text: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

While they aren't capable of creating plans of their own, they avoid obvious barriers and self-destructive situations.

content.text: A sphinx of wonder is brightly feathered and the size of a lion cub. One comes into being every time a unique idea is conceived on the Material Plane. Each sphinx of wonder is fascinated by a particular type of story or field of study, and it learns all it can about that topic. It bears a unique sigil on its forehead that suggests the type of knowledge that fascinates it. Sometimes, a sphinx of wonder forms a bond with a mortal scholar and aids them in their research.
