actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 60 ft. *Hit:* 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.text: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points). Only a *[Wish](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/wish)* spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 40/160 ft. *Hit:* 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.text: *Charisma Saving Throw:* DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). *Failure:* The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.text: The sprite casts *[Invisibility](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/invisibility)* on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

content.text: A single stirge is usually little more than an annoyance, but several can be deadly if they attach faster than a victim can remove them.

more.text: The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 60/240 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile (Recharge 5–6)
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. *Response:* The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack's force. *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. *Failure:* 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. *Hit:* 22 (4d10) Force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The golem casts the *[Slow](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/slow)* spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

data.languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text: The golem can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The golem has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Sword
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Thunderbolt
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +14, range 500 ft. *Hit:* 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Deafened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/deafened) conditions until the start of the giant's next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Storm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high [Cylinder](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cylinder) originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. *Failure:* 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. *Success:* Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

data.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Truesight 30 ft., Passive Perception 20

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The giant can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Fiendish Touch
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.text: The succubus casts *[Dominate Person](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/dominate-person)* (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, one creature [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) by the succubus within 5 feet. *Failure:* 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. *Success:* Half damage. *Failure or Success:* The target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.text: The succubus shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small Humanoid or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its [Fly Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/fly-speed) is available only in its true form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.text: When the succubus finishes a [Long Rest](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/long-rest), it can shape-shift into an [Incubus](srd-5.2/14/incubus/incubus), using that stat block instead of this one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and can't teleport.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, reach 15 ft. *Hit:* 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +19, reach 30 ft. *Hit:* 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition.

actions.name: Thunderous Bellow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 27, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot [Cone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cone). *Failure:* 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the [Deafened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/deafened) and [Frightened](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/frightened) conditions until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

more.text: If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone).

bonus_actions.name: Swallow
bonus_actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 27, one Large or smaller creature [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). *Failure:* The target is swallowed, and the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition ends. A swallowed creature has the [Blinded](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/blinded) and [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) conditions and can't teleport, it has [Total Cover](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/cover) against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

legendary_actions.name: Onslaught
legendary_actions.text: The tarrasque moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: World-Shaking Movement
legendary_actions.text: The tarrasque moves up to its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed). At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot [Emanation](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/emanation) originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose [Concentration](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/concentration) and, if Medium or smaller, have the [Prone](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/prone) condition. The tarrasque can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the tarrasque can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The tarrasque regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.text: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The tarrasque has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.text: If the tarrasque is targeted by a *[Magic Missile](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/magic-missile)* spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

content.text: Toughs might work in groups at the direction of a leader, or individual toughs might bully weaker folk into doing what they say.

actions.name: Mace
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +3, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The tough has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

content.text: Tough bosses leverage their street smarts, brawling prowess, and reputation to compel others to follow their demands.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +4, range 100/400 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The tough has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hail of Bark
actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +10, range 180 ft. *Hit:* 28 (4d10 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Animate Trees (1/Day)
actions.text: The treant magically animates up to two trees it can see within 60 feet of itself. Each tree uses the Treant stat block, except it has Intelligence and Charisma scores of 1, it can't speak, and it lacks this action. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same [Initiative](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/initiative) count, and it obeys the treant. A tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, the treant dies, or it is more than 120 feet from the treant. The tree then takes root if possible.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 10 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Charge
bonus_actions.text: The troll moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) straight toward an enemy it can see.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
traits.text: If the troll ends any turn [Bloodied](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/bloodied) and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a [Troll Limb](srd-5.2/14/troll/troll-limb). The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 [Exhaustion](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/exhaustion) level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The troll regains 15 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Rend
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: The limb regains 5 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) at the start of each of its turns. If the limb takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the limb's next turn. The limb dies only if it starts its turn with 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Troll Spawn
traits.text: The limb uncannily has the same senses as a whole troll. If the limb isn't destroyed within 24 hours, roll 1d12. On a 12, the limb turns into a [Troll](srd-5.2/14/troll/troll). Otherwise, the limb withers away.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The unicorn makes one Hooves attack and one Radiant Horn attack.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Radiant Horn
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 9 (1d10 + 4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text: The unicorn casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

bonus_actions.name: Unicorn's Blessing (3/Day)
bonus_actions.text: The unicorn touches another creature with its horn and casts *[Cure Wounds](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/cure-wounds)* or *[Lesser Restoration](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/lesser-restoration)* on that creature, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Charging Horn
legendary_actions.text: The unicorn moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) without provoking [Opportunity Attacks](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/opportunity-attacks), and it makes one Radiant Horn attack.

legendary_actions.name: Shimmering Shield
legendary_actions.text: The unicorn targets itself or one creature it can see within 60 feet of itself. The target gains 10 (3d6) [Temporary Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/temporary-hit-points), and its AC increases by 2 until the end of the unicorn's next turn. The unicorn can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the unicorn can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The unicorn regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If the unicorn fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The unicorn has [Advantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/advantage) on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

content.text: Vampire familiars are living people who serve vampires, either willingly or due to coercion by their deathless masters. They channel deathly energy through their weapons, incapacitating unsuspecting targets and leaving their victims as helpless prey for their vampire masters.

Many vampire familiars aspire to eventually become vampires, while others are magically charmed or serve as part of some terrible bargain. In each case, these vampire servants show signs of their vampiric corruption, such as corpse-like complexions, uncanny reflexes, and evidence of their masters' repeated feedings. A vampire familiar loses its supernatural abilities and returns to its original Humanoid state if its vampire master is destroyed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The familiar makes two Umbral Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Umbral Dagger
actions.text: *Melee or Ranged Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. *Hit:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) by this attack, the target becomes [Stable](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/stable) but has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition for 1 hour. While it has the [Poisoned](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/poisoned) condition, the target has the [Paralyzed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/paralyzed) condition.

bonus_actions.name: Deathless Agility
bonus_actions.text: The familiar takes the [Dash](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dash) or [Disengage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disengage) action.

traits.name: Vampiric Connection
traits.text: While the familiar and its vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with the familiar telepathically, and the vampire can perceive through the familiar's senses.

content.text: Vampire spawn are newly created vampires. They have yet to fully master their abilities, and many are consumed by their thirst for blood. Vampire spawn might serve more powerful vampires or pursue their own depraved agendas.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vampire makes two Claw attacks and uses Bite.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (2d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 14, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled), [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated), or [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition. *Failure:* 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) equal to that amount.

bonus_actions.name: Deathless Agility
bonus_actions.text: The vampire takes the [Dash](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/dash) or [Disengage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disengage) action.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.label: Forbiddance
items.text: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

items.label: Running Water
items.text: The vampire takes 20 Acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

items.label: Stake to the Heart
items.text: The vampire is destroyed if a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into the vampire's heart while the vampire has the [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated) condition.

items.label: Sunlight
items.text: The vampire takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has [Disadvantage](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/disadvantage) on attack rolls and ability checks.

traits.name: Vampire Weakness
traits.text: The vampire has these weaknesses:

content.text: Vampires are terrifying hunters and manipulators. They use their powers to shape-shift and bend other creatures' wills as they terrorize and feed on populations over generations.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.text: The vampire makes two Grave Strike attacks and uses Bite.

actions.name: Grave Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 8 (1d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled) condition (escape DC 14) from one of two hands.

actions.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the [Grappled](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/grappled), [Incapacitated](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/incapacitated), or [Restrained](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/restrained) condition. *Failure:* 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. The target's [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) by this damage and then buried rises the following sunset as a [Vampire Spawn](srd-5.2/14/vampires/vampire-spawn) under the vampire's control.

bonus_actions.name: Charm (Recharge 5–6)
bonus_actions.text: The vampire casts *[Charm Person](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/charm-person)*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17), and the duration is 24 hours. The [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) target is a willing recipient of the vampire's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was [Charmed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/charmed) by the vampire.

more.text: While in bat form, the vampire can't speak. Its game statistics, other than its size and [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), are unchanged.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, the mist can do so, but it can't pass through liquid. It has [Resistance](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/resistance) to all damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.text: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ([Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) 5 ft., [Fly Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/fly-speed) 30 ft.) or a Medium cloud of mist ([Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed) 5 ft., [Fly Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/fly-speed) 20 ft. [hover]), or it returns to its vampire form. Anything it is wearing transforms with it.

legendary_actions.name: Beguile
legendary_actions.text: The vampire casts *[Command](srd-5.2/07/spell-descriptions/command)*, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17). The vampire can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Deathless Strike
legendary_actions.text: The vampire moves up to half its [Speed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/speed), and it makes one Grave Strike attack.

data.legendary_header: Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the vampire can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The vampire regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

more.text: While it has 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) in mist form, it can't return to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the [Paralyzed](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/paralyzed) condition until it regains any [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), and it regains 1 [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) after spending 1 hour there.

traits.name: Misty Escape
traits.text: If the vampire drops to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) outside its resting place, the vampire uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If it can't use Shape-Shift, it is destroyed.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.label: Forbiddance
items.text: The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

items.label: Running Water

content.text: White dragon wyrmlings usually head off on their own soon after hatching. While the cold means little to these creatures, food is scarce in arctic realms, and predators there are merciless. Most white dragon wyrmlings survive by scavenging, hunting opportunistically, and quickly fleeing foes—including other white dragons.

traits.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 [Hit Points](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points), it makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a [Critical Hit](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/critical-hit). On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 [Hit Point](srd-5.2/08/rules-definitions/hit-points) instead.

content.text: Ogre zombies serve as tireless labor and undying weapons of war. These massive zombies possess the size and strength to break through barriers that repel smaller zombies.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. *Hit:* 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
